test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which compound is used to remove skins from tomatoes, potatoes and other fruits and vegetables for canning and as an ingredient in food preservatives, which helps prevent the growth of mold and bacteria in food?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium hydroxide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sodium hydroxide,** also known as** caustic soda, white caustic, and lye**, is employed in **removing skins from fruits and vegetables** for canning and as an ingredient in food preservatives.
 
• It is also commonly used in food processing, such as curing olives
